data.text:
M.D.Kuriakose vs The State Of Kerala on 18 January, 2024 
Author: C.S.Dias Bench: C.S.Dias Crl.Rev.Pet No.523/2020 1/1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE C.S.DIAS  Thursday, the 18th day of January 2024 / 28th Pousha, 1945  CRL.M.APPL.NO.2/2020 IN CRL.REV.PET NO. 523 OF 2020  CMP 863/2018 IN CC 314/2016 OF JUDICIAL FIRST CLASS MAGISTRATE COURT, NJARAKKAL  PETITIONERS/REVISION PETITIONERS/ACCUSED A2 AND A4:
 1. M.D.KURIAKOSE, INDRIYA BEACH RESORT AND SPA, CHERAI. 
 2. M/ S INDRIYA BEACH RESORT AND SPA (A DIVISION OF GREEN HOPPER BEACH  AND RESORT PVT. LTD.) IX-1061-A, MLA ROAD, CHERAI (REPRESENTED BY  THE FIRST REVISION PETITIONER)
 RESPONDENT/RESPONDENT:
 1. THE STATE OF KERALA, REPRESENTED BY PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, HIGH COURT OF  KERALA, ERNAKULAM. 
 2. THE FOOD SAFETY OFFICER, VYPIN CIRCLE,(FORMERLY EDAPPALLY CIRCLE),
 EROOR SOUTH PO, THRIPUNITHURA. 
 3. ADDLR3. SHINO BABY, (RESTAURANT MANAGER), INDRIYA BEACH RESORT AND  SPA (A DIVISION OF GREEN HOPPER BEACH AND RESORT PVT . LTD.),
 XI/1061 A, MLA ROAD, CHERAI RESIDING AT CHENGAMANADU HOUSE,
 KUTHUKUZHY, KOTHAMANAGALAM,
 4. ADDL.R4. SHAJU JOHN, KURU AGENCIES, (DEALERS PROVISION AND HOTEL  SUPPLIERS), 1/489, KIZHAKKEKARA, CHETHIKODE P.O., ERNAKULAM 682 315.
 ARE IMPLEADED AS ADDITIONAL RESPONDENTS 3 AND 4 AS PER ORDER DATED  6/4/22 IN CRL MA 2/22 IN CRL RP 523/2020. 
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein, the  High Court be pleased to stay all the further proceedings in C.C  No.314/2016 on the files of the Honourable Judicial First Class Magistrate  Court, Njarakkal till the disposal of the above Criminal Revision  Petition. 
 This application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this Court's order dated 21-07-2023 and upon hearing the  arguments of M/S.ALEX.M.SCARIA & SARITHA THOMAS, Advocates for the  petitioners and of PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the first respondent, the Court  passed the following:
M.D.Kuriakose vs The State Of Kerala on 18 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82026134/
1  ORDER Interim order is extended by one month. 
Sd/-
C.S.DIAS, JUDGE 18-01-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar M.D.Kuriakose vs The State Of Kerala on 18 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82026134/ 
2
